test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence.**

The walls of the temple caved __out__ due to weak construction.
solution: The correct answer is "**in**" [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence is: • **The walls of the temple caved in__ due to weak construction.** • The **preposition "in**" is the appropriate word to use in the given sentence as it means **to collapse or give way towards the inside**. • "**Out**" would mean **to expand or move away from the inside**, which is the **opposite** of what happened in this case. Thus, ***option 4*** is the correct answer. __**Correct sentence**__: *The walls of the temple caved **in** due to weak construction. * [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** __ • **Around: **located or situated on every side. • **At: **expressing location or arrival in a particular place or position. • **Apart: **to or on one side; at a distance from the main body. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__** • **In**: अंदर की ओर गिरना या रास्ता देना • **Out**: अंदर से विस्तार या दूर जाना • Around: हर तरफ स्थित या स्थित। • At: स्थान या किसी विशेष स्थान या स्थिति में आगमन व्यक्त करना। • Apart: एक तरफ या एक तरफ; मुख्य शरीर से कुछ दूरी पर 6e:T1215, The correct answer is "**custom**"
